fullTextEN: Hello, everyone!
I am Nika.
I come from Anhui, China.

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: I now live in Hefei, Anhui Province.
I really like a brand.

fullTextZH: 可能很多人都知道，叫香奈儿。
fullTextEN: Maybe many people know it, it's called Chanel.

fullTextZH: 他卖的衣服、包包，还有香水都很贵。
fullTextEN: The clothes, bags, and perfumes he sells are all very expensive.
But do you know?
Chanel at first

fullTextZH: 并不是给有钱人做衣服的。
fullTextEN: was not making clothes for rich people.

fullTextZH: 为什么香奈儿设计了很多简单、好看，
fullTextEN: Why did Chanel design many simple and beautiful
classic clothes?
Today I want to share with you

fullTextZH: 一位很勇敢的女性的故事，
fullTextEN: the story of a very brave woman,

fullTextZH: 也要分享我喜欢这个品牌的原因。
fullTextEN: and also share why I like this brand.

fullTextZH: 可可·香奈儿出生在法国。
fullTextEN: Coco Chanel was born in France.
She was very poor as a child.
Her mother died very early,

fullTextZH: 爸爸把她送到了孤儿院。
fullTextEN: and her father sent her to an orphanage.

fullTextZH: 一般没有爸爸妈妈的孩子
fullTextEN: Generally, children without parents
Will be sent to the orphanage.

fullTextZH: 她在这里学习了做衣服。
fullTextEN: She learned to make clothes here.

fullTextZH: 孤儿院里面的修女都只穿黑色的衣服，
fullTextEN: The nuns in the orphanage only wore black clothes,
and had no jewelry at all,
very simple.

fullTextZH: 这对香奈儿以后的设计
fullTextEN: This greatly influenced Chanel's later designs
and had a great impact.
At the age of 18,
Chanel left the orphanage.
She had no home,
and could only find work herself.
She first helped others mend clothes,
and later went to sing.
Because her singing was pleasant,

fullTextZH: 她喜欢唱一首叫《Qui qu'a vu Coco》的歌。
fullTextEN: she liked to sing a song called 'Qui qu'a vu Coco'.
I found it,
let's listen to it.
This is roughly how it goes.
So everyone called her Coco,
which is Coco in Chinese.
More than 100 years ago in France,
The skirts that girls wore
had very large hems,

fullTextZH: 裙子里也要穿得厚厚的，
fullTextEN: and inside the skirts, they had to wear thick layers,
making it inconvenient to walk.

fullTextZH: 而且衣服上有很多的东西，
fullTextEN: Moreover, the clothes had many things on them,
making them heavy and expensive.
Chanel thought:

fullTextZH: 女生的衣服为什么不能简单一点、
fullTextEN: Why can't women's clothes be simpler,
more comfortable?

fullTextZH: 当时很多在工厂工作的女人，
fullTextEN: At that time, many women working in factories
wore clothes that were very inconvenient,
greatly affecting their work.

fullTextZH: 不舒服的衣服让她们的工作更难、更累。
fullTextEN: Uncomfortable clothes made their work harder and more tiring.

fullTextZH: 所以香奈儿就想做一种
fullTextEN: So Chanel wanted to make a kind of

fullTextZH: 让普通女人、需要工作的女人
fullTextEN: clothing for ordinary women, women who needed to work,
that was easy to wear,
comfortable clothes,

fullTextZH: 让她们干活的时候更方便。
fullTextEN: making it more convenient for them to work.
She was very bold,

fullTextZH: 用男生的衣服布料做女生的衣服，
fullTextEN: Using men's clothing fabric to make women's clothes,
because these fabrics are very durable,
and they are also very comfortable to wear.
She also shortened the skirt,

fullTextZH: 把衣服的袖子也改短了，
fullTextEN: and also shortened the sleeves of the clothes,

fullTextZH: 就是为了让在工厂工作的女人
fullTextEN: just to make it more convenient for women working in factories

fullTextZH: 工作、走路的时候更方便。
fullTextEN: to work and walk more conveniently.

fullTextZH: 她的设计让女生的衣服变得简单、舒服又高级。
fullTextEN: Her designs made women's clothes simple, comfortable, and elegant.
Before that,

fullTextZH: 女生的衣服又复杂又重，
fullTextEN: women's clothes were complex and heavy,
and wearing them was tiring.

fullTextZH: 据说有一次可可·香奈儿要去海边玩，
fullTextEN: It is said that once Coco Chanel wanted to go to the beach,
but didn't have suitable clothes,

fullTextZH: 她就拿了一件男生的衣服，
fullTextEN: so she took a men's shirt,
cut the sleeves short,

fullTextZH: 又做了一条简单的裙子。
fullTextEN: and made a simple skirt.

fullTextZH: 没想到穿出去之后，大家都觉得很好看。
fullTextEN: Unexpectedly, after wearing it out, everyone thought it looked great.
This was the earliest form of the famous

fullTextZH: 香奈儿衣服设计风格最早的样子。
fullTextEN: Chanel clothing design style.

fullTextZH: 很多女生说，穿香奈儿的衣服工作，
fullTextEN: Many women say that working in Chanel clothes
I feel like I'm just like the boys,

fullTextZH: 工作的时候看起来又好看又专业。
fullTextEN: I look both attractive and professional at work.

fullTextZH: 我小的时候个子比较高，
fullTextEN: When I was young, I was relatively tall,

fullTextZH: 性格和大部分的女生不像，
fullTextEN: My personality is not like most girls,
So when I was a child,

fullTextZH: 男生在我看来也并没有多么的高大。
fullTextEN: boys didn't seem that tall to me.
I don't need their protection,
so I've always been very independent,

fullTextZH: 任何事情都是自己来做决定。
fullTextEN: I make decisions on my own for everything.

fullTextZH: 我觉得香奈儿是一个很勇敢、
fullTextEN: I think Chanel is very brave,
a very impressive person.

fullTextZH: 她设计的衣服让我觉得：
fullTextEN: The clothes she designs make me feel:

fullTextZH: 我们不是为了让男人们开心而穿衣服，
fullTextEN: We don't dress to make men happy,

fullTextZH: 我们穿衣服只为了自己的舒服。
fullTextEN: we dress only for our own comfort.
Some might ask:
Chanel is so expensive,
why do people still buy it?

fullTextZH: 因为它不仅是一件衣服
fullTextEN: Because it's not just a piece of clothing
or a bag,

fullTextZH: 它呢，更代表着一种风格和态度。
fullTextEN: it represents a style and attitude.
Simple, confident, elegant.

fullTextZH: 据说她一生谈了30多个男朋友。
fullTextEN: It is said she had over 30 boyfriends in her life.
In her lifetime,

fullTextZH: 曾经有很多个情人，没有生孩子。
fullTextEN: She once had many lovers and did not have children.

fullTextZH: 她最爱的一个情人叫亚瑟·卡博。
fullTextEN: Her most beloved lover was named Arthur Capel.
This man was very handsome,
and also very wealthy.

fullTextZH: 他对香奈儿的事业有很大的帮助。
fullTextEN: He greatly helped Chanel's career.

fullTextZH: 香奈儿靠着他开了第一家店。
fullTextEN: Chanel opened her first store with his support.
It is said that now Chanel's logo,
the two Cs,
is just combining Chanel's name

fullTextZH: 和这个情人的名字放在了一起。
fullTextEN: with this lover's name together.
While dating,
she developed her career with her lover's help.
She developed her own career.

fullTextZH: 她真的是很有野心的女人。
fullTextEN: She truly was a very ambitious woman.

fullTextZH: 但是不喜欢她的人会觉得，嗯，
fullTextEN: But those who don't like her might think, um,
her love life was chaotic,

fullTextZH: 靠着男人才能发展得这么好。
fullTextEN: and she could only succeed by relying on men.
What do you think?
I think she is also lonely.

fullTextZH: 最后一个人在酒店里死去。
fullTextEN: The last person died in the hotel.

fullTextZH: 不知道她的30多位情人里面，
fullTextEN: Among her more than 30 lovers,
whom did she love,
who truly loved her.
Do you like Chanel?
Why?

fullTextZH: 你最喜欢的衣服品牌是什么呢？
fullTextEN: What is your favorite clothing brand?
Feel free to leave me a message!

fullTextZH: 今天的内容就到这里啦。
fullTextEN: That's all for today's content.
See you next time, bye!
